verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents its own REST API, which can send in events related to a lead, apply Action Plans, and manually trigger Automations for a person. An agent could use these to record signals and set next steps. Person stages exist, but no endpoint for updating deal stages is shown, and there is no MCP server. Missing for 10: a documented deal/stage update endpoint, an MCP server, documented ingestion of email or meeting signals through the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Follow Up Boss provides a simple [REST API](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) that allows developers to integrate their applications quickly.
Send in a lead or an event related to a lead.
Apply an Action Plan to a person.
Manually trigger an Automation for a specified Person.
